name: Battle Bots
blurb: Pre-war Security Robots are still on patrol. Be wary of crossing their paths.

stages.log_text: I've engaged a pre-war security robot for the Hornwright Mining Company. If I can take it down, it might have something valuable for me.
The Hornwright Security Robot is retreating for repairs. If I follow it, it may lead me to some useful supplies.
I defeated a pre-war Security Robot from the Hornwright Mining Company. If I can get into the bunker it came from, I might find something useful.
I've found the pre-war bunker used for housing the Hornwright Mining company's security robot. If I want to shut this all down, I'll need to get the keycards off Mr. Gutsy Robots...
Two access panels need to be activated to enable the master shutdown. I'll have to be quick, or get some help.
The Master Shutdown for the Hornwright Security Bot has been enabled. Someone needs to hit it, and fast.
After fighting a pre-war Security Robot, I found the bunker it came from and helped myself to some of the materials inside.
